title: knowledge.faultline_enriched.v1
description: Integration-contract v1 for the FaultlineEnriched event payload (M5 EB-03; current wire shape frozen). Carries a coarse headline so Governance can re-evaluate without fetching the whole card.

Score.description: CVE-intrinsic composite priority (0-100); optional additive field (C6) — Governance's blast multiplier scales it.

Applicabilities.description: Reconciled vendor VEX statements (EDR-VEX-01 D5); optional additive field. Governance raises a system not_affected Proposal from a not_affected statement whose package matches a Finding's component.

Scope.description: The product the VENDOR said this statement covers, classified from the source document's structured CPE (EDR-VEX-02 D5). Part of the statement, NOT a conclusion about it — whether the scope covers a release is the consumer's own determination and never overwrites Status or Justification. EMPTY Family/Major means the vendor supplied no readable scope, which a consumer MUST read as applicability `unknown` (epistemic uncertainty), never as a product mismatch. Additive and non-breaking: the field is always present once emitted (a struct, so it does not omit), and an older consumer ignores it.

Family.description: Distribution/product family, e.g. `enterprise-linux` for RHEL and its 1:1 rebuilds.

Major.description: Major version of that family, e.g. `8`.

AffectedRanges.description: Reconciled backport-aware affected range (D3); optional additive field. Governance re-evaluates existing Findings against it (EDR-TRUST-01 T5).

HeadlineTrust.description: Trust class of the source that won the headline severity/CVSS (EDR-TRUST-01 T2); optional additive field. Absent means no headline evidence contributed.

RangeTrust.description: Highest-risk trust class among sources contributing affected ranges / fixed versions (T3); optional additive field.

SignalTrust.description: Highest-risk trust class among sources contributing exploit signals (T3); optional additive field.
